kjv: I speak the truth in Christ, [and] lie not
mine: I am telling the truth, I am not lying
note: TR adds "en Christo"; absent from Sinaiticus*, A, D*, F, G.

kjv: nor to usurp authority over the man
mine: or to exercise authority over a man
note: authentein (only here in the NT) is debated; the KJV's "usurp" assumes the authority is illegitimate, a sense the word may or may not carry.
